csv_scope_of_work: The City of Racine and its Community Development Authority ( City ) is pleased to announce this offering of a key downtown development site consisting of approximately 1.63 acres of developable land ( Site ). The City considers the Site an asset to the economic growth of the City. Located on Lake Avenue, the Site has significant development value with incredible unobstructed lakefront views. It is within walking distance to Festival Park, Main Street, and the broader downtown. The purpose of this Request for Qualifications (RFQ) is to solicit the interest of potential developers or development teams. The City desires that the Site be developed for high density and market-rate residential, or mixed-use development.
